title: Services - Ba-Suka Energy
metaDescription: Ba-Suka Energy services: SIRA battery swapping, solar-powered Swap & Glow stations, EV mobility infrastructure, and household power — 100% solar, women-led, grid-independent in Burkina Faso.

sections.heading: Empowering the Future of African Mobility
sections.body: At Ba-Suka Energy, we don’t just provide power; we provide a professional, women-led infrastructure designed to eliminate the barriers to electric vehicle adoption. By combining cutting-edge solar technology with standardized battery systems, we ensure that clean mobility is reliable, affordable, and accessible for everyone—from individual riders to large-scale commercial fleets.

sections.heading: DMS Battery-Swapping Infrastructure
sections.intro: We eliminate “range anxiety” and long charging wait times by providing a standardized, professional swapping network

items.title: The 60-Second Swap
items.body: Our stations allow riders to exchange a depleted battery for a fully charged one in less time than it takes to refuel a petrol bike.

items.title: The DMS Standard
items.body: We utilize a universal battery format. This “EV-agnostic” approach means any manufacturer or fleet that adopts the DMS standard can utilize our network without proprietary lock-in

items.title: Smart BMS Monitoring
items.body: Every battery is equipped with an integrated Battery Management System (BMS) that tracks health, temperature, and cycles in real-time to ensure maximum safety.

sections.heading: Solar-Powered Energy Hubs
sections.intro: Our stations are not just points of sale; they are independent, clean-energy power plants.

items.title: Off-Grid Reliability
items.body: Every station is equipped with a high-capacity solar array and on-site energy storage, ensuring 95% uptime regardless of the local grid’s stability.

items.title: Sustainable Generation
items.body: By generating 100% of our power from the sun, we provide a truly carbon-neutral fuel source for the transport sector

items.title: Dual Charging Options
items.body: While swapping is our primary focus, our hubs also feature conventional charging points for vehicles suited for stationary plug-in charging

sections.heading: Community Energy Services
sections.intro: Beyond mobility, our stations serve as safe, reliable community hubs managed by certified local women

items.title: Ancillary Services
items.body: Customers can access essential services such as phone charging and small retail at our station locations

items.title: Professional Management:
items.body: Every station is operated by a graduate of the Ba-Suka Academy, ensuring high-quality customer service and technical expertise

sections.heading: Ba-Suka Academy: Professional Operations
sections.intro: We provide “Infrastructure-as-a-Service” by ensuring every site is managed by a certified professional.

items.title: Talent Pipeline
items.body: The Academy trains women to become “Infrastructure Managers,” covering technical maintenance, solar management, and digital point-of-sale (POS) systems.

items.title: Professional Standards
items.body: This ensures that fleet partners and individual riders receive consistent, high-quality, and safe service at every Ba-Suka location

sections.heading: Fleet & B2B Solutions
sections.intro: We offer specialized energy management for commercial partners, including logistics firms, delivery companies, and moto-taxi cooperatives.

items.title: Predictable Energy Costs
items.body: We offer subscription-based models and volume agreements that allow businesses to lock in their energy expenses and avoid petrol price volatility.

items.title: Data Transparency
items.body: Partners receive access to our data platform, providing insights into their fleet’s energy consumption, battery health, and operational efficiency

sections.eyebrow: Scale Your Impact. Power Your Fleet
sections.heading: Join West Africa’s most trusted women-led energy network
sections.body: Ba-Suka Energy offers a bankable, solar-powered infrastructure platform designed for commercial growth. Whether you are an EV manufacturer, a logistics firm, or an impact investor, we provide the standardized technology and certified operations needed to drive the clean-energy transition across Africa.

sections.heading: Our Mission Is is to position women as visible leaders and trusted operators at the front line of Burkina Faso’s clean-energy and mobility transition
sections.body: This is achieved by developing a women-led, solar-powered infrastructure platform that provides safe and reliable energy services to the community
